data.summary: Over 20 years’ experience with top tier IT organizations as a Lead Business Analyst and Product Owner in end-to-end project/program management using Agile SCRUM, KANBAN, Waterfall, and Iterative Processes. Having a demonstrated history of proven capabilities in leading globally distributed cross-functional teams. Possess exceptional record of accomplishment with process improvements and delivering new products with strong background in Product Management, Business Development, Monitoring Performance and delivering end-to-end solutions.

responsibilities: Project - Bulk Data Feeds generation and Distribution capability

DaaS - It is the data that is available in the DaaS Platform and has been published as a Product. Data as a Product is the product management principles to data with focus on ownership, usability, and quality.
This includes building the Bulk Data feeds generation and distribution capability via Microsoft Purview and Microsoft Fabric applications to address data usability issues.
Files are retrieved via a series of API endpoints that allow clients to request data on a frequency that meets their needs. The two data file types are:
o Request initialization files o Request incremental files
Generate initialization and incremental files for each bulk data feed

product when updated data is received from MS Purview. These queries are saved, and then run at pre-defined times in MS Fabric, and the resulting files stored in Azure Cloud Storage. Clients would make API calls to request initialization or incremental updates to the Bulk Data Feed products that they have subscribed to, and the API would return URLs of the file generated by the above process to the client. The client would access the URLs and download the desired files locally into their system.
Run the Blob Storage Reader pipeline for latest version of the data files.
Remove the older versions of the files in Manifest Lakehouse in MS Fabric.

Project - JSND - Unemployment Insurance Modernization

Job Service North Dakota (JSND) serves as the North Dakota state’s premiere source for workforce assistance programs. Whether an individual is an employee, employer or seeking employment, training, or labor market information; Job Service can provide an array of resources to assist each customer on an individual basis.

The JSND Unemployment Insurance Modernization project consists of modernizing Microsoft Access applications to a Web based application to enhance security and improve client access. The focus is reducing vendor reliance and allowing for future enhancements.

It is a completely integrated Omni-channel digital banking software framework and suite of applications that enables continuous, seamless customer journeys regardless of the touchpoint – mobile, internet, branch, or contact center.
